title: Mirror: geocontract Federated Catalog (DCAT-US 3.0.0)
description:
The geocontract federated catalog, expressed in the GSA DCAT-US 3.0.0
vocabulary. This contract governs the catalog envelope that bundles
every published *.geocontract.yaml instance record — currently the
NEPA Categorical Exclusions catalogue and the PIC NEPA Data Standard
v1.2, with room for additional agency-published contracts to be
registered over time.

table:columns.name: id
table:columns.description:
Resolvable IRI for this catalog instance. The geocontract
convention is `https://geocontract.dev/catalogs/<slug>`.

table:columns.name: type
table:columns.description: DCAT-US class. Fixed to `Catalog`.

table:columns.name: title
table:columns.description: Human-readable title of the catalog.

table:columns.name: description
table:columns.description: Plain-language summary of the catalog.

table:columns.name: publisher
table:columns.description:
Agent responsible for publishing and making the catalog
available. Inline `dcat:Agent` (name + optional url,
identifier, @id, @type).

table:columns.name: creator
table:columns.description: Array of `dcat:Agent` responsible for creating the catalog metadata.

table:columns.name: contactPoint
table:columns.description: Array of vCard `Kind` contact points.

table:columns.name: keyword
table:columns.description: Array of free-text keyword/tag strings.

table:columns.name: theme
table:columns.description: Array of `skos:Concept` themes/categories.

table:columns.name: themeTaxonomy
table:columns.description: Array of `skos:ConceptScheme` controlled vocabularies.

table:columns.name: subject
table:columns.description: Array of `skos:Concept` subjects.

table:columns.name: spatial
table:columns.description: Array of `dcterms:Location` geographic coverage records.

table:columns.name: temporal
table:columns.description: Array of `dcterms:PeriodOfTime` temporal coverage intervals.

table:columns.name: language
table:columns.description: ISO 639-1 language code(s) used for catalog metadata text.

table:columns.name: license
table:columns.description: License governing how the catalog can be used or reused.

table:columns.name: rights
table:columns.description: Array of rights-statement strings not covered by `license`.

table:columns.name: accessRights
table:columns.description: Whether the catalog is public, restricted, or not public.

table:columns.name: issued
table:columns.description: Date the catalog was formally issued.

table:columns.name: modified
table:columns.description: Most recent date the catalog content changed.

table:columns.name: identifier
table:columns.description: Main unique identifier for the catalog (URI or persistent ID).

table:columns.name: homepage
table:columns.description: Main public web page for the catalog (`foaf:Document`).

table:columns.name: hasPart
table:columns.description: List of sub-catalogs contained within this catalog.

table:columns.name: conformsTo
table:columns.description:
Standard, schema, profile, or model that this catalog follows.
For geocontract this is always `DCAT-US 3.0`.

table:columns.name: qualifiedAttribution
table:columns.description: PROV-style attributions of agents to the catalog.

table:columns.name: record
table:columns.description:
Array of `dcat:CatalogRecord` entries — one per catalogued
resource. Each record carries its own `issued`/`modified`
timestamps and a `primaryTopic` IRI pointing at the
catalogued Dataset.

table:columns.name: dataset
table:columns.description:
Array of `dcat:Dataset` entries catalogued under this
catalog. For geocontract, each entry corresponds to one
published *.geocontract.yaml instance record (currently
the NEPA CATEX catalogue and the PIC NEPA Data Standard
v1.2).

table:columns.name: service
table:columns.description: Array of `dcat:DataService` endpoints exposed by the catalog.

table:columns.name: datasetSeries
table:columns.description: Array of `dcat:DatasetSeries` groupings.
